header: One bar, several segments, a whole read as its parts
lead: Segment widths are flex ratios taken from the shares typed on the children. Make them add up to a hundred yourself — the bar does not normalise anything, it only shares out the room.
note: Use Distribution Bars when each part deserves its own row and figure, and Percentage Rings when a single share is the whole message.

metrics.title: First segment
metrics.text: The colour comes from the position, never from a field
